basis.zh-CN: 此画像根据公开岗位样本与行业说明整理，用作理解 AAA 团队中游戏设计岗位关注点的可复核参考。
basis.en: This profile synthesizes public job samples and industry guidance as a reviewable reference for game-design focus in AAA teams.

caveats.zh-CN: 这不是行业标准或唯一答案。岗位、团队结构、项目阶段和个人目标都会改变取舍；indie 与 solo 创作者的能力组合也会不同。
caveats.en: This is not an industry standard or the only answer. Roles, team structures, project phases, and personal goals change the tradeoffs; indie and solo creators also combine capabilities differently.

basis.zh-CN: 此画像基于公开 AAA 招聘样本与相邻岗位职责整理，描述大型、多专业、可能含联合开发的项目中，Creative Director 对共同创意方向、跨职能一致性和取舍的参考责任范围。
basis.en: This profile synthesizes public AAA job samples and adjacent-role evidence as a reference for a Creative Director’s responsibility for shared direction, cross-discipline coherence, and tradeoffs in large, multidisciplinary, potentially co-developed projects.

caveats.zh-CN: 这不是行业标准或唯一答案。Creative Director 在不同公司可能偏游戏整体、叙事、品牌或工作室领导；Game Director、Design Director、Art Director 与制作人之间的边界也会改变。招聘 JD 是特定项目、组织和招聘时点的样本，不能据此推断该角色必须亲自实现全部玩法、关卡、叙事或美术能力。
caveats.en: This is not an industry standard or the only answer. A Creative Director may be game-, narrative-, brand-, or studio-oriented depending on the company; boundaries with Game, Design, Art, and Production Directors also vary. Job descriptions are project-, organization-, and time-specific samples, not evidence that this role must personally execute every gameplay, level, narrative, or art capability.

sourceNote.zh-CN: 官方公开岗位页，2026-08-09 核验。明确要求定义并传达高层创意愿景，联结制作、美术与设计领导层，维持体验与品质一致性，并与制作方共同处理优先级、范围和时间线。
sourceNote.en: Official public job page, checked 2026-08-09. It calls for defining and communicating high-level creative vision, aligning production, art, and design leadership, maintaining experience and quality coherence, and aligning priorities, scope, and timelines with production.

sourceNote.zh-CN: 官方公开岗位页，2026-08-09 核验。虽非 AAA 样本，作为职位边界对照：涵盖愿景、设计标准、商业目标、跨职能协作、反馈与导师职责，说明职位覆盖面会随公司而变。
sourceNote.en: Official public job page, checked 2026-08-09. Although not an AAA sample, it is a useful title-boundary comparison: vision, design standards, commercial goals, cross-functional collaboration, feedback, and mentorship all appear, showing that the role’s coverage changes by company.

sourceNote.zh-CN: 官方 AAA 招聘页，2026-08-09 核验。Design Director 直接向 Creative Director 汇报，并把创意支柱转译为玩法循环、系统架构、评审和团队执行；这是将 Creative Director 画像保持在“方向与判断”而不是“默认亲自执行系统设计”的关键反证。
sourceNote.en: Official AAA job page, checked 2026-08-09. The Design Director reports to the Creative Director and translates creative pillars into gameplay loops, systems architecture, review, and team execution; this is key counter-evidence for keeping the Creative Director lens focused on direction and judgment rather than assuming hands-on system execution.

sourceNote.zh-CN: 官方公开岗位页，2026-08-09 核验。该专项总监与 Creative Director 及项目总监协作，负责把方向落实为动画意图、原型、交付物与质量；进一步说明 AAA 中专项执行责任常由不同负责人承担。
sourceNote.en: Official public job page, checked 2026-08-09. This specialist director works with the Creative Director and project directors while owning animation intent, prototypes, deliverables, and quality; it further shows that specialized execution responsibilities are often held by separate leaders in AAA.

basis.zh-CN: 此画像综合 GDC 的一人开发、自发行、独立团队营销、商务与 Playtest 资料。它描述独立个人在未将事项交由合作者、承包商或发行商承担时，可能需要在产品、验证、范围和对外工作之间作取舍的参考分布。
basis.en: This profile synthesizes GDC material on one-person development, self-publishing, indie marketing, business development, and playtesting. It describes the tradeoffs an independent individual may need to make across product, validation, scope, and external work when those responsibilities are not delegated to collaborators, contractors, or publishers.

caveats.zh-CN: 这不是行业标准或“一个人必须全能”的清单。Indie 不等于 solo；solo 也不等于不与发行商、自由职业者、社区、测试者或联合开发者合作。是否自发行、预算、平台、项目阶段和已有专长会显著改变优先级。成功案例与 GDC 演讲可说明具体做法及其限制，但存在幸存者偏差，不能被当作可复制保证。
caveats.en: This is not an industry standard or a demand that one person master everything. Indie does not mean solo, and solo does not mean working without publishers, freelancers, communities, testers, or co-developers. Self-publishing status, budget, platform, project phase, and existing expertise substantially change priorities. Success stories and GDC talks illuminate concrete practices and limits, but carry survivor bias and are not reproducible guarantees.
